Non-Degree Option
Non-Degree applications are accepted up until one week before the last day to register (census day) for each entry term. Census Day is the deadline to add or drop full-term (16-week) courses and the first 6-week session. You can review the academic calendar for the last day to register (census day) and other information.
There is no application fee for the non-degree application and a new application must be submitted each term in order to be registered for non-degree courses.
Mines does not process Visa’s for non-degree students.
Important Information
Application Completion
All required application materials, including letters of recommendation (if required), must be submitted on or before your program of interest’s application deadline. Your file will not be reviewed until your application AND all required materials are received. Check your admissions application account to make sure you do not have any missing items.
International Students
International students who have already obtained an F1 or J1 visa and who are currently located within the U.S. borders may apply using their program of interest’s domestic application deadline. For all other visa type holders, please email isss@mines.edu to inquire which deadline is most applicable for your case.
International Students are not eligible for residential (on-campus) certificates programs, those wanting to complete a certificate should look at online options. F-1 and J-1 visas cannot be issued for residential graduate certificate programs. If you are on a current F-1 or J-1 visa at Mines and enrolled in another graduate program, or a different visa type (such as H1B), and are interested in one of the certificate programs, you may contact ISSS to confirm your enrollment eligibility.
